content.text: The setpoint change for Zone_F2_Z01 is limited to occupied time slots (the ~5–21 o'clock setpoint decreased by about 1 °C), while the nighttime setpoint and the setpoints of all other zones (using the same building-wide occupancy schedule) have not changed. This is consistent with a local override/controller offset for that specific zone, rather than a building-wide schedule change.
